title: Dot-product may not be the optimal compatibility function
description: Experiments show that reducing the attention key size d_k hurts quality, suggesting that determining query-key compatibility is difficult and that a more sophisticated compatibility function than dot-product might yield better results.
canonical_description: dot-product compatibility function may be insufficient for learning complex query-key relationships

evidence.quote: We further observe in rows (C) and (D) that, as expected, bigger models are better, and dropout is very helpful in avoiding over-fitting. ... This suggests that determining compatibility is not easy and that a more sophisticated compatibility function than dot product may be beneficial.
